metadata.title: SPOT Knight Hacks 2026 challenge data
metadata.notice: All operational data, coordinates, facilities and images are synthetic and fictional challenge materials.
metadata.timestampPolicy: Source-local timestamps. The kit does not specify a time zone; timestamps are preserved without conversion.
metadata.thresholdPolicy: No numeric operating limits are supplied. Anomaly severity is imported from the kit and never inferred from a fabricated threshold.
metadata.confidencePolicy: GOOD and QUESTIONABLE are source quality labels, not probability estimates. Localization confidence is a specific navigation measurement, not confidence in every sensor reading.
metadata.imagePolicy: Sample images are illustrative; the kit supplies no mapping from images to individual inspections.
metadata.replayPolicy: The supplied stream contains mission and action events only. Linked CSV readings and anomalies are timestamp-gated reconstructions shown after observed action completion. They are not sensor events received over the stream.
metadata.locationPolicy: Use the action's recorded waypoint for observations. Separately disclose disagreements with the asset registry; never silently move an observation.
caveats: Mission COMPLETED does not mean every action succeeded or every inspection is clear.
Replay ends after 500 events: M023 is partial and M024–M027 have no supplied replay events.
Replay event MISSION_COMPLETED can carry details.status FAILED. The status field controls mission outcome.
Anomalies need not match the action's measurement type or imply mission failure; preserve the source flag and inspect linked evidence.
The source provides no acknowledgement, work-order, resolution, numeric operating-limit, or per-reading probability fields.
V1 and V2 have different sample sizes; observed performance differences do not establish causality.
